pages.title: Ball and Maze
pages.creator: wavegame
pages.description: Guide a rolling ball through winding courses in Ball and Maze. Drag to control its movement, gather stars, and find the exit while avoiding obstacles and dead ends. Careful direction changes help you negotiate tight corners without leaving collectibles behind.

pages.title: Battle Racing Stars
pages.creator: Yes2Games
pages.description: Race as characters from Halfbrick games in Battle Racing Stars. Jump past track hazards and activate special abilities or power-ups against the opposition. Unlock and upgrade racers such as Barry and the Ginger Ninja as you work through the competition.

pages.title: Small Wardrobe
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Make outfits for cotton dolls in Small Wardrobe. Gather tools and crafting materials, create new clothing, and organize the growing collection of dresses, shoes, and accessories. Story moments accompany the process of building and tidying the dolls' wardrobe.

pages.title: Mindblow
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Use picture clues to uncover words in Mindblow. Interpret the image, work out the intended answer, and earn coins for correct guesses. Spend those coins on hints when a harder visual riddle leaves you searching for the right word.

pages.title: ASMR Pet Treatment
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Care for a puppy and kitten in ASMR Pet Treatment. Wash them, work through gentle healing tasks, and pamper each animal before dressing it up. The pet-care sequence combines treatment activities with choosing outfits for the recovered companions.

pages.title: Marble Puzzle Quest
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Move linked marbles into matching slots in Marble Puzzle Quest. Drag a chain's arrow-marked end to guide it, sorting mixed colors as needed. Only three identical marbles disappear from the four collection spaces, so careless placement can leave no room to continue.

pages.title: BFFs K-Pop Fangirls
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Create contrasting looks for two music fans in BFFs K-Pop Fangirls. Style their professional daytime outfits, then choose clothing for their evening idol-chasing adventures. Combine hairstyles, accessories, and wardrobe pieces to match each part of their daily routine.

pages.title: Catch The Pig
pages.creator: HeiTie
pages.description: Find matching trios of pigs in Catch The Pig. Select three identical pieces to remove them and work toward completing the pig collection. Keep scanning the remaining arrangement for useful sets as you try to find every required animal.

pages.title: CraftMart
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Help a block-world shopkeeper serve hungry customers in CraftMart. Grow supplies, carry products to the counter, and collect payment at the register. Expand fields, add livestock, and enlarge the shop as its food business becomes busier.

pages.title: Chess Online
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Play computer chess at a chosen difficulty in Chess Online. Select a time format, inspect highlighted legal moves, and use hints when needed. Postgame analysis identifies mistakes, giving you specific positions to review after finishing the match.

pages.title: Online Car Destruction Simulator 3D
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Test vehicles against destructive obstacles in Online Car Destruction Simulator 3D. Drive down slopes and observe collisions that separate damaged parts from the car. Change vehicles or camera views, slow the action, and reset or repair the machine for another crash test.

pages.title: Pet Salon Simulator
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Wash, groom, and style animals in Pet Salon Simulator. Work through the care routine to transform each furry customer's appearance. The game focuses on handling the salon's treatments and completing a finished look for the pets arriving for attention.

pages.title: Block Blasty Saga
pages.creator: CursoraLabs
pages.description: Place differently shaped pieces to complete lines in Block Blasty Saga. Clear blocks to make room for further placements and increase your score. Choose an ongoing classic game or progress through the structured chapters of adventure mode.

pages.title: Driver Master Simulator
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Complete timed transport jobs in Driver Master Simulator. Start by carrying animals in a truck and earn money to unlock bus driving and helicopter tasks. Reach each destination within the job's time limit as the available vehicle types expand.

pages.title: Slenderman Back to School
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Escape a locked school during a night pursued by a monster in Slenderman Back to School. Search for clues and useful objects while staying on the move. Survive until dawn and find a way out of the threatening building.

pages.title: Shadow Fighter
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Fight side-scrolling battles in Shadow Fighter. Choose heroes for solo or team modes and use their combat abilities against the opposing side. In solo matches, a roster of three fighters continues battling until one side has been completely defeated.

pages.title: Car Racing 3D Drive Mad
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Overtake computer racers in Car Racing 3D Drive Mad. Steer clear of obstacles and collect fuel to replenish the car's nitro. Use that boost when it helps you gain ground while keeping the vehicle out of trouble.

pages.title: Toilet War: Merge Skibidi
pages.creator: Rocket Studio
pages.description: Summon fighters and strengthen them in Toilet War: Merge Skibidi. Drag two matching units together to create an improved troop, then use your force against powerful enemies. The strategy centers on building a stronger lineup through repeated combinations.

pages.title: Best Classic Mahjong Connect
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Clear matching tile pairs in Best Classic Mahjong Connect. A pair can be removed only when its connecting line turns no more than twice. Examine the layout for clear paths and keep opening space until every tile is gone.

pages.title: Summer Aesthetics
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Choose vacation wardrobes in Summer Aesthetics. Join princesses traveling to different destinations and help select outfits for their daily outings. Coordinate the available clothing and accessories so each character has a finished look for the journey.

pages.title: Bffs Love Pinky Outfits
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Dress a group of friends for a themed weekend party in Bffs Love Pinky Outfits. Browse each wardrobe for pink clothing and coordinate the pieces into a complete outfit. Give every princess her own version of the party's shared color theme.

pages.title: Pride Mahjong
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Clear food tiles in sets of three in Pride Mahjong. Move selected pieces into a seven-slot collection area, where identical trios disappear. Plan picks carefully to preserve space, using the available bonuses when the layout becomes difficult.

pages.title: Grass Cutting Puzzle
pages.creator: BestGameSpot
pages.description: Trim a virtual lawn in Grass Cutting Puzzle. Drag the mower through the grass and work from the starting section toward a clean, completed yard. Clearing the ground also supports growing flowers in the garden.

pages.title: Noob Bridge Challenge
pages.creator: Firstpixel
pages.description: Memorize the safe panels in Noob Bridge Challenge before crossing a glass bridge. Jump from one safe square to the next until you reach the far side. Later levels make the remembered route harder to follow without stepping on a dangerous panel.

pages.title: Freecell Solitaire Blue
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Sort a fully exposed deck in Freecell Solitaire Blue. Use four temporary free cells to reorganize the eight tableau piles and uncover useful cards. Build the foundations upward by suit from ace to king to complete the game.

pages.title: Slope Run
pages.creator: Greenlight
pages.description: Guide an astronaut-ball through a space tunnel in Slope Run. Move left and right and jump as you travel toward other planets to recover lost memories. Keep following the route while handling the tunnel's changing course.

pages.title: Draw Love Story
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Complete romantic scenes with your drawings in Draw Love Story. Inspect the situation, infer the missing element, and sketch something that resolves the couple's problem. Each puzzle asks you to turn an unfinished scenario into a happier outcome.

pages.title: Trader Rush
pages.creator: Bermuda Games
pages.description: Collect goods and choose when to sell them in Trader Rush. Control the character along the route while watching the timing of each trade. Good selling decisions matter to the result you earn when the run reaches its final reward.

pages.title: Gravity Soccer 3
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Remove objects to direct a football into the goal in Gravity Soccer 3. Click blocks away and let gravity carry the ball through the layout. Try to collect all the stars while arranging a successful route into the net.

pages.title: Canoniac Launcher
pages.creator: Garbuz Studio
pages.description: Send a robot flying in Canoniac Launcher. Aim the cannon, hold to build power, and release to launch Jimmy across the course. Earn cash for equipment upgrades and use weapons or bombs to help extend the distance of later attempts.

pages.title: Amazing Jewel
pages.creator: Amazing Games Network
pages.description: Swap adjacent gems to make matching rows in Amazing Jewel. Line up three identical jewels to clear them and work through the level challenges. Search the board for useful exchanges as you try to complete each matching puzzle.

pages.title: Hit Cans 3D
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Knock down stacked tins in Hit Cans 3D. Drag to line up a ball, choose where to aim, and release the throw. Place impacts where they can disturb the arrangement and bring down more of the cans.

pages.title: Ball Hop
pages.creator: Rokito Games
pages.description: Keep a ball bouncing onward in Ball Hop. Use the mouse to guide its movement and try to travel farther on each attempt. The arcade challenge centers on maintaining the run while pushing toward a higher score.

pages.title: Conquer The City
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Capture every settlement in Conquer The City. Connect cities to attack rival colors while defending your own territory. Turn the entire map blue to win, choosing when to send forces and when your existing cities need protection.

pages.title: Super Friday Night Squid Challenge
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Win rhythm battles in Super Friday Night Squid Challenge. Follow the arrows and keep up with each song as the characters compete for a large fictional prize. Complete the musical stages without losing track of the sequence of inputs.

pages.title: Greedy Cats Jumper
pages.creator: Labogames
pages.description: Jump between platforms in Greedy Cats Jumper while avoiding crabs, birds, spiders, and spikes. Pick up tools such as jetpacks, magnets, and shields to support the climb. Choose a black or white cat and work toward a stronger leaderboard result.

pages.title: Adam and Eve Go 2
pages.creator: Functu
pages.description: Help a prehistoric traveler bring a flower home in Adam and Eve Go 2. Cross dangerous levels, climb ladders, and get past dinosaurs and traps. Guide Adam through the obstacles so he can complete the journey to Eve.

pages.title: City Bike Stunt 2
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Race motorcycles through stunt courses in City Bike Stunt 2. Beat timed levels to unlock bikes or collect diamonds in the free-riding area for garage upgrades. Customize the machines and play alone or with a second rider.

pages.title: Mr Secret Agent
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Solve compact shooting challenges in Mr Secret Agent. Aim at enemies and use the game's physics to work through each scenario. Fifty levels offer different arrangements, making each encounter a small puzzle about placing your shots effectively.

pages.title: Chibi DottedGirl Coloring Book
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Create colorful superhero pictures in Chibi DottedGirl Coloring Book. Choose a chibi-style drawing and add the colors you want to its outlined areas. Finish the illustration and capture a screenshot to keep or share your version.

pages.title: Safari Ride Difference
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Search paired safari scenes for small changes in Safari Ride Difference. Select the details that do not match while watching the timer. The game tracks the differences you find, turning close inspection of each vehicle-themed image into the main challenge.

pages.title: Cool Cars Jigsaw Puzzle
pages.creator: GamesFine.com
pages.description: Assemble vehicle scenes in Cool Cars Jigsaw Puzzle. Eight pictures offer three grid sizes, ranging from six to twenty-four pieces. Drag each section to its correct spot and complete the selected car image before choosing another arrangement.

pages.title: Aquarium Farm
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Care for fish and build their home in Aquarium Farm. Maintain your aquarium, attend to its inhabitants, and take on fish-doctor activities when they need help. The game connects looking after the pets with creating their underwater environment.

pages.title: Flower Shooter
pages.creator: Yellow Bird Games
pages.description: Hit every plant target in Flower Shooter. Tap to fire, choose different guns, and use boosters to help complete the shooting challenges. New locations and backgrounds provide further settings as you work toward clearing each group of flowers.

pages.title: Barbecue Picnic Hidden Objects
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Look for concealed grill shapes in Barbecue Picnic Hidden Objects. Each picture contains ten barbecues to find, and six levels provide different picnic scenes. Inspect the details and click the hidden objects to complete each search.

pages.title: Cartoon Farm Spot the Difference
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Compare illustrated rural scenes in Cartoon Farm Spot the Difference. Examine both pictures and select the details that have changed between them. The challenge is to distinguish small alterations among the farm's otherwise matching shapes and objects.

pages.title: Virus Jigsaw
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Reassemble microscopic-themed images in Virus Jigsaw. Choose from twelve virus illustrations and select one of three puzzle modes. Fit the scattered sections together to rebuild the selected picture, then try another image or difficulty setting.

pages.title: Merge Balls
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Shoot matching balls together in Merge Balls. Aim so pieces of the same color meet, combining them into higher-level balls that can explode. Successful merging earns additional shooting opportunities as you work toward increasing the score.

pages.title: Tank VS Zombies 2
pages.creator: Arcade Lemon
pages.description: Drive an armed vehicle against incoming undead in Tank VS Zombies 2. Move the tank into position and use its gun to kill the zombies. The action centers on keeping the vehicle fighting as more enemies approach.

pages.title: Endless Flight
pages.creator: gameworld
pages.description: Keep an aircraft airborne in Endless Flight while collecting coins. Use the spacebar or mouse button to adjust its vertical movement. The longer you survive, the higher your score grows, giving you another distance-and-survival target each attempt.

pages.title: Panda Story
pages.creator: y9-games.com
pages.description: Guide a panda through difficult stages in Panda Story. Move with the keyboard, jump over the route's obstacles, and enter doors to continue. The adventure focuses on getting the panda safely through each area of the course.

pages.title: Tetro Attack
pages.creator: Fat Boy Studio
pages.description: Dodge falling block shapes in Tetro Attack. Move the ball left or right to change its direction and gather gold while avoiding the approaching tetrominoes. One collision ends the attempt, so every movement must account for the next incoming piece.

pages.title: Dinosaur Memory Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Reveal dinosaur cards in Dinosaur Memory Challenge and remember their positions. Turn over two at a time to look for identical pairs. Use what you have already seen to match the remaining creatures and clear the whole arrangement.

pages.title: Car Chaser
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Escape pursuing police vehicles in Car Chaser. Steer with the joystick, collect points, and avoid collisions with the cars following you. The driving challenge continues for as long as you can keep your car out of their path.

pages.title: Princess Mermaid Accident ER
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Treat an injured underwater princess in Princess Mermaid Accident ER. Follow the illustrated medical tasks to disinfect and stitch her wound, then complete the remaining care steps. The game presents a hospital-style treatment sequence in a sea setting.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Christmas Surprise
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Search for a missing present in Baby Hazel Christmas Surprise. Join Hazel, Santa, and the other children on a sleigh trip to the North Pole. Interact with the characters and objects as they work to recover the lost gift.

pages.title: FZ Tank vs Tiles
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Select a firing color in FZ Tank vs Tiles and shoot at the colored tile targets. Use mouse or touch input to manage the tank's shots. Keep making successful attacks while trying to improve the score from your previous attempt.

pages.title: AXE.IO
pages.creator: BRAVO
pages.description: Fight other arena characters with thrown weapons in AXE.IO. Move around the playfield and launch axes toward opponents while avoiding their attacks. The contest centers on surviving close encounters and increasing your kills through accurate throws.

pages.title: Emoji link : the smile game
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Clear identical smiley tiles in Emoji link : the smile game. Select matching icons whose connecting path fits within the game's line restriction. Remove every pair before the timer expires to advance to a harder board of emoticons.

pages.title: Moto X3M Spooky Land
pages.creator: MadPuffers
pages.description: Ride through Halloween obstacle courses in Moto X3M Spooky Land. Control the motorcycle over ramps, perform stunts, and survive hazards that can cause explosive crashes. Each stage challenges you to balance speed with keeping the rider on the course.

pages.title: Highway Traffic Bike Stunts
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Ride a motorcycle through road traffic in Highway Traffic Bike Stunts. Steer past vehicles and generate ramps with the spacebar to perform stunts. The game combines navigating a busy highway with creating opportunities to launch the bike into the air.

pages.title: Modern Car Parking HD
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Practice placing a car in designated spaces in Modern Car Parking HD. Use keyboard steering to guide the vehicle through the parking challenge. Carefully adjust the approach and final position to complete the task without losing control of the car.

pages.title: Fireman Jet
pages.creator: Isaske Games
pages.description: Extinguish building fires and rescue people and animals in Fireman Jet. Move upward and sideways to reach burning areas while collecting coins. Putting out more fires increases your score, and coins can unlock additional character skins.

pages.title: Armed Road
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Drive a heavily armed car through a crime-filled city in Armed Road. Use the vehicle's weapons to fight the gangsters threatening the streets. The game combines controlling your car with clearing hostile forces along the road.

pages.title: Dirt Bike Rider
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Handle a motorcycle through nine stages in Dirt Bike Rider. Use WASD to control the bike and work toward a stronger score. Each level provides another riding challenge as you continue through the course sequence.

pages.title: Tactical Weapon Pack 2
pages.creator: Wilkin Games
pages.description: Practice firearm handling in Tactical Weapon Pack 2. Try weapons in the firing range or enter ranked challenges to earn experience and money. Spend earnings on guns and attachments, with accuracy and performance influencing the rewards from your shooting.

pages.title: Tiny Alien
pages.creator: A Small Game
pages.description: Recover sacred gems in Tiny Alien by jumping through hostile space levels. Your flying companion automatically shoots nearby enemies while you handle movement past pits, saws, and missiles. Pick up or buy power-ups and unlock additional playable characters.

pages.title: Fruit Master 2
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Time blade throws to cut moving fruit in Fruit Master 2. Try to slice several pieces with one throw for a score bonus, but do not miss. The challenge depends on accuracy as you work toward reaching later levels.

pages.title: Tug of War Zombie
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Pull against a friend's undead team in Tug of War Zombie. Each side begins with four zombies and tries to drag the opposition toward the razors. Losing a zombie reduces that team's strength, making each pull part of a dangerous contest.

pages.title: Top Burger
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Run a burger counter in Top Burger. Prepare each order according to what the customer wants and keep the cooking moving. The challenge is to assemble the requested food quickly enough to handle the shop's demand.

pages.title: Minicars
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Race compact cars on cartoon tracks in Minicars. Choose a vehicle and play alone or against another person across three levels. Work on handling the course while competing to finish ahead of the other drivers.

pages.title: Rocket Jump
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Climb toward the top in Rocket Jump. Jump across gaps and past traps as the levels become harder, with greater distances separating safe positions. The game challenges you to keep timing each leap accurately as the route grows more demanding.

pages.title: Balloons Path Swipe
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Connect matching balloons in Balloons Path Swipe. Draw a line through balloons sharing a color to form a match. Scan the arrangement for groups you can link and continue clearing the colored pieces from the play area.

pages.title: Fashion Cover Diva
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Style models for magazine shoots in Fashion Cover Diva. Prepare six characters by selecting looks for their fashion-cover appearances. Coordinate the available styling choices so each model is ready for her turn in front of the camera.

pages.title: Animals Crush Match
pages.creator: Freelance
pages.description: Make matching groups of animals in Animals Crush Match. Find three or more identical pieces and remove them through the puzzle's matching actions. Keep comparing the board's animals to locate another useful combination among the remaining pieces.

pages.title: Lets go Fishing
pages.creator: Onduck Games
pages.description: Catch fish to earn money in Lets go Fishing. Reach each level's earnings target before time expires, then spend the money to unlock more valuable fish. Better catches help you meet the next goal within the available time.

pages.title: He Likes The Darkness
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Open the exit portal by gathering stars in He Likes The Darkness. Explore the puzzle-adventure stages to find every required collectible, then continue to the next area. Coins provide a separate reward that unlocks additional characters.

pages.title: Fairy Tinker Makeover
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Prepare a fairy to meet her friends in Fairy Tinker Makeover. Choose an outfit and pair it with a set of wings. Compare the available pieces and coordinate them into a complete fantasy look for the outing.

pages.title: Flakboy Lab Escape
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Escape an experimental laboratory in Flakboy Lab Escape. Jump over platforms, traps, and explosive hazards while running toward each assignment's distance goal. Collect coins to buy aids such as shields, health, and magnets between attempts.

pages.title: Lappa Jigsaw
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Put together illustrated scenes in Lappa Jigsaw. Arrange each puzzle's pieces to reveal the finished picture, with animations adding movement to the completed activity. The game focuses on rebuilding the image by finding where its sections belong.

pages.title: Sery Bride Dolly Makeup
pages.creator: GlossyPlay
pages.description: Prepare a wedding look in Sery Bride Dolly Makeup. Open mystery boxes to discover cosmetics, then try eyeshadow, lashes, blush, and lipstick. Match the makeup with a hairstyle and dress while working toward the game's styling achievements.

pages.title: Truck Traffic
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Drive a heavy vehicle along the road in Truck Traffic. Accelerate, brake, and steer with the arrow keys to control its movement. Watch the surrounding traffic and keep the truck on a clear path through each driving challenge.

pages.title: Dove Halloween Dolly Dress Up H5
pages.creator: GlossyPlay
pages.description: Choose a costume from mystery fashion options in Dove Halloween Dolly Dress Up H5. Combine clothing, shoes, and accessories into a Halloween look. Unlock achievements, review outfits in the gallery, and save a picture of your finished costume.

pages.title: Eliza Dressing Room
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Help an expectant princess choose an outing look in Eliza Dressing Room. Browse her clothing options and coordinate an outfit for leaving home. The game centers on comparing the wardrobe choices and dressing Eliza for the occasion.
